info.title: web-repo-to-ai REST API
info.description: Universal URL & GitHub Repository to AI-Ready Content Converter API. High-performance, streaming-capable engine for transforming web articles, documentation sites, public and private GitHub repositories into standardized Markdown, TXT, JSON, HTML, JSONL, and structured ZIP archives optimized for LLM context windows.
